name: Ring Triceps Extension with False Grip
description: A ring triceps extension performed with a false grip where the thumb wraps around the same side as the fingers. The false grip on rings creates a different wrist angle and increases the stability challenge. This variant is used in gymnastic strength training progressions.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Ring Triceps Extension with False Grip in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Ring Triceps Extension with False Grip.
steps: Step 1: Grip rings with false grip, thumb alongside fingers not wrapping.
Step 2: Extend body forward at angle, arms straight.
Step 3: Lower head between rings by bending elbows, maintaining false grip pressure.
Step 4: Press through triceps to full extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: False grip requires practice to master
